{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Cobble Crusher Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Cobble Crusher Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Cobble Crusher Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Cobble Crusher Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Forging the [[Boulder Breaker]] }} |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 30 }} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Cobble Crushers''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Cobble Crusher|Cobble Crushers|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Cobble Crusher}} Cobble Crushers are two-handed [[Weapon]]s created by [[Goron]]s. They are very thick but do not possess a cutting edge. Therefore, they are consequently used as crushing Weapons, due to the weight of their component metal. They belong to the [[Goron Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons that are made by Gorons. They are most commonly found around [[Goron City]] in the [[Eldin Canyon]] and throughout the [[Eldin Mountains]]. In addition to this, they have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s found from scanning the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Daruk]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Should [[Link]] ever lose the [[Boulder Breaker]], he can ask [[Rohan]] in Goron City to make him a new one in exchange for a Cobble Crusher, a [[Diamond]], and five pieces of [[Flint]]. Cobble Crushers have a hidden property which causes their damage output to be doubled when used on the [[Ore Deposit]] atop a [[Stone Talus]]. In this vein, they will immediately destroy [[Stone Pebblit]]s when used against them. As Cobble Crushers are made out of metal, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. This also means that they can be manipulated through the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Finally, they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if Link has one equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_036" |Life = 30 |Power = 15 |SpHitActor = "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint", "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint_02", "Enemy_Golem_R_WeakPoint" {{List Note|All Talus weakpoints}} |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = true |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 14 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 26 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 28 |BuyingPrice = 110 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Two-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Cobble Crusher}} {{Stub|TotK}} Cobble Crushers reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Daruk Weapon }} Cobble Crushers are [[Weapon]]s that can be used by [[Daruk]] and can be acquired whenever a [[Scenario]] or a [[Challenge]] is completed with Daruk as a participant. They can also be acquired from the [[Treasure Chest]]s that appear when a [[Powerful Foe]] is defeated or when an [[Outpost]] is captured if Daruk is one of the selected [[Warrior]]s. At the [[Hylian Blacksmith Guild]], the Warriors can sell Cobble Crushers, raise their Weapon-level limits, remove any of their [[Seal]]s, or fuse them into other Weapons owned by Daruk to form stronger ones. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Cobble Crusher appears in {{AoI}}, where several Gorons, such as [[Pastos]], wield it. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Cobble Crusher Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for a Cobble Crusher File:AoI Cobble Crusher Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Icon for a Cobble Crusher ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cobble Crusher✨ * Decayed Weapon * Goron Gear * Two-Handed Weapon * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Cobble Crusher}}
